doc:
**`HasDSDimLE.hasNatarajanDimLE` has no converse.** The six-cycle on a two-point domain has
Natarajan dimension `1`, a Natarajan witness on both points being a four-cycle, while its whole
trace family is a two-dimensional pseudo-cube, so its DS dimension is at least `2`.

This is the hexagon Brukhim, Carmon, Dinur, Moran and Yehudayoff record after their Definition 6,
and the four-cycle test the proof turns on is their Example 7. Their Theorem 2 pushes the
separation to a class of Natarajan dimension `1` and infinite DS dimension; that construction
rests on hyperbolic pseudo-manifolds and is cited in the module docstring rather than formalised
here.
